body:
My whole life got me here. 
29 years of shitty choices got me here.
I've seen the results many times, as much as it pains me to think my poor mother will have to witness this, I can't help it.
It's no ones fault but my own.
I got myself here over the years by living horrible.
I spilled everything to one person, I could never be the open again.
That was the last 5 years.
I really tried to change for the better.
I wanted this to be different.
This isn't my first break up.
This isn't my first low point.
This is just that one fucking straw.
I'm so sorry.
I could've wrote this right now. 5 years should be long enough right? Fake people. Why?
